items.comment: The new block's two description sentences are word-for-word identical to the opening of the comprehensive pre-existing block at lines 18-19. If Scaladoc renders the comment closest to the `class` keyword (i.e. this new block rather than the one before the annotations), the extensive examples, @see links, and policy prose in the first block would be silently dropped. The structural decision to keep two blocks is pre-existing and out of scope here, but the content duplication is worth a second look to confirm the rendering intent is correct.
Lowercase, no trailing period, clear phrasing. Matches the pre-existing param text exactly.
